description: This file defines a custom exception class RoleNotFoundException used in the user administration module of the project. It extends AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException and provides constructors for different ways of identifying a missing role, either by id or name.

classes.name: RoleNotFoundException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating that a user role resource was not found, supporting identification by role ID or name.

methods.name: RoleNotFoundException(final Long id)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a role ID, indicating the role with this ID does not exist.

methods.name: RoleNotFoundException(final String name)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a role name, indicating the role with this name does not exist.

methods.name: RoleNotFoundException(Long id, EmptyResultDataAccessException e)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a role ID and an underlying data access exception.
